summary: SCHMID Group N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release with unaudited H1 2026 results and updated FY2026 guidance. The CFO comments on converting liabilities into equity, raising financing, reducing overhead, and implementing cost programs, but no special-situation transaction is described. This is a routine earnings and guidance update, not an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special situation. The filing includes forward-looking statements and standard exhibit information.
